items.title: NYSE’s Chris Bergan Explains Why Large Caps are Transferring to the NYSE
items.summary:
NYSE Director of Listings Chris Bergin joins NYSE Live to discuss why a growing number of high-profile companies are choosing to transfer their listings to the New York Stock Exchange.

The conversation follows Kraft Heinz's transfer to the NYSE and explores broader listing trends, including recent moves by companies such as AstraZeneca, Fifth Third Bancorp, and Skydance. Bergin discusses the factors companies evaluate when considering an exchange transfer, including visibility, liquidity, market structure, and access to the NYSE's unique trading floor ecosystem.

He also explains the role of Designated Market Makers (DMMs) in the NYSE's market model, how the exchange supports listed companies through advisory services and capital markets resources, and why financial institutions continue to make the NYSE their listing venue of choice.

Watch NYSE Live for insights into capital markets, exchange listings, and the trends shaping the public company landscape.
